ocl.definition: uid: String, fee: Real, user: User = User.allInstance()->any(o | o.UserID = uid), result: Boolean
ocl.precondition: user.oclIsUndefined() = false and User.allInstance()->includes(user) and user.OverDueFee >= fee
ocl.postcondition: let a:Real = user.OverDueFee - fee in user.OverDueFee = a and result = (a = 0.0)
